premise: Beaver finds the biggest stick in the forest stuck fast in the meadow; Bear cub pulls, Rabbit pulls Bear cub, and only when tiny Mouse joins — POP! — out it comes and they tumble in a heap.
inspiration: The Enormous Turnip (Russian folk), turned with a stick, a count of pullers and a heap of giggles — and the smallest puller's proud last word.
lesson: Every helper counts, even the smallest.

en-US.title: The Stick That Would Not Budge
en-US.text: {beaver:enter} Beaver found the best stick in the whole forest, stuck fast in the ground. {beaver:face happy} [excited] "Just what I need!" {beaver:live pull} He pulled and he pulled. Heave-ho! But the stick wouldn't budge. Along came {bear:enter} Bear cub. {bear:go to beaver} "I'll help!" Two pulling now. {bear:shake} Heave-ho! It wouldn't budge. {rabbit:enter} Rabbit came hopping. {rabbit:go to bear} Three pulling now. {rabbit:shake} Heave-ho! Still it wouldn't budge. {beaver:face sad} [sighs] Then tiny {mouse:enter} Mouse scampered up to see what the fuss was. {mouse:live sniff} "Can I help?" {bear:face surprised} "You?" said Bear cub. "You're so small!" {mouse:go to rabbit} But Mouse pulled Rabbit, Rabbit pulled Bear cub, Bear cub pulled Beaver, and Beaver pulled the stick. {mouse:live pull} Four pulling now! HEAVE… HO! {sfx:pop} POP! {beaver:spin} {bear:spin} {rabbit:spin} {mouse:spin} Out came the stick, and {sfx:tumble} down they tumbled in a heap. {all:face happy} [laughs] {beaver:live gnaw hold} Beaver held up his stick. "Who pulled it out?" asked Rabbit. [proudly] {mouse:live talk} "We all did," squeaked Mouse. {mouse:hop x2} "I just pulled LAST."

es-ES.title: El palo que no se movía
es-ES.text: {beaver:enter} Castor encontró el mejor palo de todo el bosque, bien clavado en el suelo. {beaver:face happy} [excited] —¡Justo lo que necesito! {beaver:live pull} Tiró y tiró… pero el palo, ni se movió. Llegó {bear:enter} Osito. {bear:go to beaver} —¡Te ayudo! Ya eran dos tirando. {bear:shake} Tiraron y tiraron… y el palo, ni se movió. {rabbit:enter} Conejo llegó saltando. {rabbit:go to bear} Ya eran tres. {rabbit:shake} Tiraron y tiraron… y nada, ni se movió. {beaver:face sad} [sighs] Entonces el pequeño {mouse:enter} Ratón se acercó a ver qué pasaba. {mouse:live sniff} —¿Os ayudo? {bear:face surprised} —¿Tú? —dijo Osito—. ¡Si eres muy pequeño! {mouse:go to rabbit} Pero Ratón tiró de Conejo, Conejo tiró de Osito, Osito tiró de Castor, y Castor tiró del palo. {mouse:live pull} ¡Ya eran cuatro! ¡A la de una, a la de dos… y a la de TRES! {sfx:pop} ¡PLOP! {beaver:spin} {bear:spin} {rabbit:spin} {mouse:spin} Salió el palo, y {sfx:tumble} rodaron todos por la hierba, unos encima de otros. {all:face happy} [laughs] {beaver:live gnaw hold} Castor levantó su palo. —¿Quién lo ha sacado? —preguntó Conejo. [proudly] {mouse:live talk} —Todos —dijo Ratón con su vocecita—. {mouse:hop x2} Yo solo he tirado el ÚLTIMO.

ja-JP.title: うんとこしょ、どっこいしょ
ja-JP.text: {beaver:enter}ビーバーくんが、森でいちばんのぼうを見つけました。じめんに、しっかりささっています。{beaver:face happy}[excited]「これ、ほしかったんだ！」 {beaver:live pull}うんとこしょ、どっこいしょ。それでも、ぼうはぬけません。{bear:enter}こぐまがきて、{bear:go to beaver}「てつだうよ！」 ふたりで、{bear:shake}うんとこしょ、どっこいしょ。それでも、ぬけません。{rabbit:enter}ウサギくんも、ぴょんぴょん。{rabbit:go to bear}さんにんで、{rabbit:shake}うんとこしょ、どっこいしょ。まだまだ、ぬけません。{beaver:face sad}[sighs]ちいさな{mouse:enter}ネズミくんが、なにかなと、ちょろちょろ。{mouse:live sniff}「てつだおうか？」 {bear:face surprised}「きみが？」 とこぐま。「そんなにちいさいのに！」 {mouse:go to rabbit}ネズミくんがウサギくんを、ウサギくんがこぐまを、こぐまがビーバーくんを、ビーバーくんがぼうをひっぱって…{mouse:live pull}よにんで、うんとこしょ…どっこいしょ！{sfx:pop}すっぽーん！{beaver:spin}{bear:spin}{rabbit:spin}{mouse:spin}ぼうがぬけて、{sfx:tumble}みんな、どっしーん、ころころ。{all:face happy}[laughs]{beaver:live gnaw hold}ビーバーくんは、ぼうをたかくかかげました。「だれがぬいたの？」 とウサギくん。[proudly]{mouse:live talk}「みんなでだよ」 とネズミくん。{mouse:hop x2}「ぼくは、さいごにひっぱっただけ」

de-DE.title: Der Stock rührt sich nicht
de-DE.text: {beaver:enter} Der Biber fand den besten Stock im ganzen Wald. Er steckte fest im Boden. {beaver:face happy} [excited] „Genau so einen brauche ich!“ {beaver:live pull} Er zog und zog. Hau ruck! Aber der Stock rührte sich nicht. Da kam {bear:enter} das Bärchen. {bear:go to beaver} „Ich helfe dir!“ Jetzt zogen schon zwei. {bear:shake} Hau ruck! Der Stock rührte sich nicht. {rabbit:enter} Der Hase kam angehoppelt. {rabbit:go to bear} Jetzt zogen schon drei. {rabbit:shake} Hau ruck! Der Stock rührte sich immer noch nicht. {beaver:face sad} [sighs] Da flitzte die winzige {mouse:enter} Maus herbei, um zu sehen, was da los war. {mouse:live sniff} „Kann ich helfen?“ {bear:face surprised} „Du?“, fragte das Bärchen. „Du bist doch so klein!“ {mouse:go to rabbit} Aber die Maus zog am Hasen, der Hase zog am Bärchen, das Bärchen zog am Biber, und der Biber zog am Stock. {mouse:live pull} Jetzt zogen vier! HAU… RUCK! {sfx:pop} PLOPP! {beaver:spin} {bear:spin} {rabbit:spin} {mouse:spin} Heraus kam der Stock, und {sfx:tumble} alle purzelten übereinander. {all:face happy} [laughs] {beaver:live gnaw hold} Der Biber hielt seinen Stock hoch. „Wer hat ihn rausgezogen?“, fragte der Hase. [proudly] {mouse:live talk} „Wir alle“, piepste die Maus. {mouse:hop x2} „Ich hab nur als LETZTE gezogen.“

fr-FR.title: Le bâton qui ne bougeait pas
fr-FR.text: {beaver:enter} Castor a trouvé le plus beau bâton de toute la forêt, bien planté dans le sol. {beaver:face happy} [excited] « Juste ce qu’il me faut ! » {beaver:live pull} Il a tiré, tiré. Oh, hisse ! Mais le bâton n’a pas bougé. Voilà qu’arrive {bear:enter} Ourson. {bear:go to beaver} « Je vais t’aider ! » Les voilà deux à tirer. {bear:shake} Oh, hisse ! Le bâton n’a pas bougé. {rabbit:enter} Lapin est arrivé en sautillant. {rabbit:go to bear} Les voilà trois à tirer. {rabbit:shake} Oh, hisse ! Le bâton ne bougeait toujours pas. {beaver:face sad} [sighs] Alors {mouse:enter} Souris, toute menue, est accourue voir ce qui se passait. {mouse:live sniff} « Je peux aider ? » {bear:face surprised} « Toi ? a dit Ourson. Mais tu es si petite ! » {mouse:go to rabbit} Mais Souris a tiré Lapin, Lapin a tiré Ourson, Ourson a tiré Castor, et Castor a tiré le bâton. {mouse:live pull} Les voilà quatre à tirer ! OH… HISSE ! {sfx:pop} PLOP ! {beaver:spin} {bear:spin} {rabbit:spin} {mouse:spin} Le bâton est sorti, et {sfx:tumble} ils sont tous tombés les uns sur les autres. {all:face happy} [laughs] {beaver:live gnaw hold} Castor a brandi son bâton. « Qui l’a arraché ? » a demandé Lapin. [proudly] {mouse:live talk} « Nous tous ! » a couiné Souris. {mouse:hop x2} « Moi, j’ai juste tiré en DERNIER. »

it-IT.title: Il bastone che non si muoveva
it-IT.text: {beaver:enter} Castoro ha trovato il bastone più bello di tutto il bosco, piantato ben fermo nel terreno. {beaver:face happy} [excited] «Proprio quello che mi serve!» {beaver:live pull} Ha tirato e tirato. Oh, issa! Ma il bastone non si muoveva. Ecco arrivare {bear:enter} Orsetto. {bear:go to beaver} «Ti aiuto io!» Adesso tiravano in due. {bear:shake} Oh, issa! Niente da fare. {rabbit:enter} Coniglio è arrivato saltellando. {rabbit:go to bear} Adesso tiravano in tre. {rabbit:shake} Oh, issa! Il bastone, niente: non si muoveva. {beaver:face sad} [sighs] Poi il piccolo {mouse:enter} Topolino è corso a vedere che cosa succedeva. {mouse:live sniff} «Posso aiutare?» {bear:face surprised} «Tu?» ha detto Orsetto. «Ma sei così piccolo!» {mouse:go to rabbit} Ma Topolino ha tirato Coniglio, Coniglio ha tirato Orsetto, Orsetto ha tirato Castoro, e Castoro ha tirato il bastone. {mouse:live pull} Adesso tiravano in quattro! OH… ISSA! {sfx:pop} PLOP! {beaver:spin} {bear:spin} {rabbit:spin} {mouse:spin} Fuori il bastone! E {sfx:tumble} giù tutti a gambe all'aria, uno sopra l'altro. {all:face happy} [laughs] {beaver:live gnaw hold} Castoro ha sollevato il suo bastone. «Chi l'ha tirato fuori?» ha chiesto Coniglio. [proudly] {mouse:live talk} «Tutti insieme», ha squittito Topolino. {mouse:hop x2} «Io ho solo tirato per ULTIMO.»

zh-TW.title: 拔不動的木棍
zh-TW.text: {beaver:enter}河狸找到了全森林最棒的一根木棍，可是它牢牢地插在土裡。{beaver:face happy}[excited]「這正是我要的！」 {beaver:live pull}牠拔呀拔。嘿呦，嘿呦！可是木棍拔不動。{bear:enter}小熊來了。{bear:go to beaver}「我來幫忙！」 現在兩個一起拔。{bear:shake}嘿呦，嘿呦！還是拔不動。{rabbit:enter}兔子跳了過來。{rabbit:go to bear}現在三個一起拔。{rabbit:shake}嘿呦，嘿呦！還是拔不動。{beaver:face sad}[sighs]這時，{mouse:enter}小老鼠一溜煙跑過來，想看看發生了什麼事。{mouse:live sniff}「我可以幫忙嗎？」 {bear:face surprised}「你？」 小熊說，「你那麼小！」 {mouse:go to rabbit}可是，小老鼠拉著兔子，兔子拉著小熊，小熊拉著河狸，河狸拉著木棍。{mouse:live pull}現在四個一起拔！嘿呦……嘿呦！{sfx:pop}啵！{beaver:spin}{bear:spin}{rabbit:spin}{mouse:spin}木棍拔出來了，{sfx:tumble}大家咕咚一聲，跌成一堆。{all:face happy}[laughs]{beaver:live gnaw hold}河狸把木棍舉得高高的。「是誰拔出來的？」 兔子問。[proudly]{mouse:live talk}「是我們大家呀！」 小老鼠吱吱地說。{mouse:hop x2}「我只是……最後一個拉的。」

zh-HK.title: 拉唔郁的木棍
zh-HK.text: {beaver:enter}海狸找到了全森林最好的一枝木棍，可是它牢牢地插在泥土裏。{beaver:face happy}[excited]「正係我想要嘅！」 {beaver:live pull}牠拉呀拉。一、二、三——拉！可是木棍一動也不動。{bear:enter}小熊來了。{bear:go to beaver}「我幫你！」 現在兩個一起拉。{bear:shake}一、二、三——拉！木棍還是一動也不動。{rabbit:enter}兔子跳過來。{rabbit:go to bear}現在三個一起拉。{rabbit:shake}一、二、三——拉！木棍仍然一動也不動。{beaver:face sad}[sighs]這時，細細粒的{mouse:enter}小老鼠走過來，看看發生了甚麼事。{mouse:live sniff}「使唔使我幫手呀？」 {bear:face surprised}「你？」 小熊說，「你咁細粒！」 {mouse:go to rabbit}可是小老鼠拉着兔子，兔子拉着小熊，小熊拉着海狸，海狸拉着木棍。{mouse:live pull}現在四個一起拉！一……二……三……拉！{sfx:pop}啵！{beaver:spin}{bear:spin}{rabbit:spin}{mouse:spin}木棍拔出來了，{sfx:tumble}大家咚的一聲，跌成一堆。{all:face happy}[laughs]{beaver:live gnaw hold}海狸把木棍舉得高高的。「係邊個拉出嚟㗎？」 兔子問。[proudly]{mouse:live talk}「係我哋大家呀！」 小老鼠吱吱地說。{mouse:hop x2}「我淨係排喺最尾拉啫！」

pop.prompt: a big comic pop as a stuck stick comes out of the ground, playful

tumble.prompt: a soft thump and rustle of small animals tumbling together into long grass, gentle, realistic
